chapterTitle: Misperception Strategies: Weave a Seamless Blend of Fact and Fiction
coreMove: Shape the opponent's picture of reality by controlling which signals are emphasized and how they are interpreted.
reversal: Legitimate framing becomes propaganda when the operator hides core reality or induces false belief instead of guiding attention among true facts.
teachingEmphasis: name the line between sequencing truth and creating false belief
treat perception management as high-risk for trust and consent
